gen-gf-chilanka-outfit: Outfit draws its curves as bent cable, smooth and unswelling, finishing well before they close. Chilanka brings the relaxed hand-drawn charm up top, though neither is meant for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-chilanka-plus-jakarta-sans: Chilanka writes its headings with a loose, graceful hand, counters left open to the outside. Plus Jakarta Sans follows in a plain sans, precise and monoline, made for short stretches of reading.
gen-gf-chilanka-space-grotesk: Chilanka's relaxed, hand-drawn lettering is unmistakable at a glance. Space Grotesk adds a geometric ribbon of constant width beneath it, so loose handwriting meets crisp construction, and both suit short stretches of reading.
gen-gf-coiny-fs-rowan: Coiny crowds its headings with tightly shut c, e and s shapes and extra-wide spacing between characters. Rowan, a classic serif with generous curve openings, would read friendly and literary, though the pair is better for brief copy.
gen-gf-comic-neue-fs-amulya: Amulya sets a contemporary sans-serif body with generously open curves, modern and quiet. And Comic Neue does the casual, pen-drawn greeting best, its thin unshaded outline the opposite of that crisp tidiness.
gen-gf-comic-neue-fs-neco: Comic Neue draws each heading glyph as if with a single pen tip, friendly and openly casual. Neco's text serif tapers gently, so enlarge it a touch.
gen-gf-comic-neue-fs-plein: Plein is reliable and tidy, with a clear channel leading into every round letter. Comic Neue's rope-thin handwriting loosens the top of the page, while Plein keeps the smaller text composed and comfortable in small doses.
gen-gf-comic-neue-fs-recia: Friendly and inviting, Comic Neue letters its headings with bowls drawn at stem thickness, like a casual pen line. Recia, a classic serif, narrows gradually and sharply.
gen-gf-comic-neue-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans reads contemporary and approachable, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems and identical weight in verticals and horizontals. Comic Neue's casual hand sits comfortably above it.
gen-gf-comic-neue-fs-synonym: Open c forms that never close into rings give Comic Neue its relaxed, pen-drawn look. Synonym does dependable work below, a plain sans stripe of constant ink.
